acerca_titulo: Our Trajectory, Values and Commitment to Your Tax Peace of Mind
acerca_desc: Specialized accounting firm led by CPA Lourdes Cusihuaman, former SUNAT tax officer and graduate of the University of Lima, dedicated to protecting your business and optimizing your taxes in Peru.
historia_titulo: Accounting Advisory with Direct Tax Audit and SUNAT Experience
historia_parrafo_1: At Estudio Cusihuaman, our mission is clear: to simplify the Peruvian tax system and provide freelancers, entrepreneurs, and small businesses with honest, rigorous, and transparent tax guidance.
historia_parrafo_2: Under the leadership of CPA Lourdes Cusihuaman, with over 10 years of professional experience and direct background as a SUNAT tax advisory officer, we implement preventative strategies that protect client assets and avoid penalties or tax audits.
pilar_1_desc: All financial records and SOL portal credentials are strictly protected under professional mandate and encrypted security standards.
pilar_2_desc: Continuous monitoring of official tax notifications and inquiries to act before statutory deadlines expire.
pilar_3_desc: Physical office in Jr. Dante 260, Surquillo (Lima) and virtual consultation via video conference for clients across Peru and abroad.
pilar_4_desc: We explain exactly what taxes apply, why, and how to legitimately optimize tax deductions in plain language.
mision_desc: Guide entrepreneurs and independent contractors toward financial formalization and sustainable growth, ensuring punctual tax compliance.
vision_desc: To be the benchmark accounting and tax firm in Lima and online throughout Peru, recognized for integrity, human closeness, and technical excellence.
